mapper.select: select detail_id from inv_transfer_detail where transfer_id = #{transferId} order by detail_id for update

select warehouse_id, write_mode, read_mode, reconcile_status, last_reconcile_time, last_reconcile_batch, approved_by, approved_time from inv_warehouse_stock_mode where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} for update

select policy_id, item_type, item_id, allocation_policy, tracking_policy, status, version from inv_item_fulfillment_policy where
(item_type = #{item.itemType} and item_id = #{item.itemId})
order by item_type, item_id for update

select balance_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, warehouse_id, lot_id, location_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version from inv_stock_balance_detail where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and
(item_type = #{item.itemType} and item_id = #{item.itemId})
order by balance_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_shipment_allocation ( shipment_id, shipment_detail_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, balance_id, lot_id, location_id, policy_rank, allocation_policy, tracking_policy, allocated_quantity, balance_version_before, balance_version_after, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, summary_stock_log_id, command_request_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{shipmentId}, #{shipmentDetailId}, #{transferId}, #{transferDetailId}, #{balanceId}, #{lotId}, #{locationId}, #{policyRank}, #{allocationPolicy}, #{trackingPolicy}, #{allocatedQuantity}, #{balanceVersionBefore}, #{balanceVersionAfter}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{costPrice}, #{totalCost}, #{summaryStockLogId}, #{commandRequestId}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )

insert into inv_transfer_shipment_serial ( allocation_id, shipment_id, serial_id, serial_no_snapshot, item_type, item_id, source_balance_id, source_lot_id, source_location_id, status_before, status_after, create_by, create_time ) values
(#{item.allocationId}, #{item.shipmentId}, #{item.serialId}, #{item.serialNoSnapshot}, #{item.itemType}, #{item.itemId}, #{item.sourceBalanceId}, #{item.sourceLotId}, #{item.sourceLocationId}, #{item.statusBefore}, #{item.statusAfter}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())

insert into inv_stock_ledger_detail ( request_id, command_request_id, shipment_allocation_id, summary_stock_log_id, warehouse_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, movement_type, business_type, business_id, business_no, from_balance_id, from_lot_id, from_location_id, change_quantity, before_quantity, after_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, operator_user_id, operator_name, occurred_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{requestId}, #{commandRequestId}, #{shipmentAllocationId}, #{summaryStockLogId}, #{warehouseId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{productId}, #{movementType}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{businessNo}, #{fromBalanceId}, #{fromLotId}, #{fromLocationId}, #{changeQuantity}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{costPrice}, #{totalCost}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{occurredTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
